note: BH-8651: minutes after which POST /api/pm/briefs/claim releases a `claimed` PM brief row (a run that died after its claim) to the next claim, with one stage_events CLAIM_RELEASED row. Read by the jobs worker claimTimeoutMin from settings lane.pm-groom.pm_claim_timeout_min (seed 120); a row lane.pm-groom.<project>.pm_claim_timeout_min wins. A value that is not 0 and not 30..10080, or not an integer, is the next source down, then the code fallback 120. The box lane bin/pm-groom.sh does not read it.
